as_told.title: Steinman's book and FOIA on the Interplanetary Phenomenon Unit

plain: An Army group called the Interplanetary Phenomenon Unit is said to have existed and to have handled UFO matters. Its existence, the story goes, came to light in 1986 and 1987 through requests made under the Freedom of Information Act, a US law that lets anyone ask for government records. A researcher named William Steinman is said to have made those requests. The researcher known as UAPGerb tells it this way, naming Steinman and the researcher Kevin Randall among those who uncovered it. Michels repeats it in a later episode, saying "we know due to Bill Steinman and his work" that the unit existed. He places the unit itself in 1947 to 1950 and links the find to Steinman's 1986 book UFO Crash at Aztec. If the records are as described, the Army had an official unit for things from beyond Earth.
